description:
Implement secure file sharing for the 'LogShareApp' Android project. The app generates a log file at 'filesDir/app_logs.txt' but crashes when trying to share it because it uses a file:// URI.

Your tasks:
1. Create a 'provider_paths.xml' file in 'res/xml' to expose the internal files directory ('files-path') with the name 'logs' and path '.'.
2. Configure the 'androidx.core.content.FileProvider' in AndroidManifest.xml with the authority 'com.example.logshare.fileprovider', set exported to false, grantUriPermissions to true, and link the xml resource.
3. Update MainActivity.kt's 'shareLogFile()' function to use 'FileProvider.getUriForFile()', create an ACTION_SEND Intent with type 'text/plain', add the 'FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION' flag, and launch the chooser.

Ensure the project compiles successfully after your changes.
